evidence: Modifies validation flush logic in src/validation.cpp and block storage management in src/node/blockstorage.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Decoupling block file flushing and pruning from FlushStateToDisk cleanly separates block storage from chainstate and directly unblocks libbitcoinkernel pruned storage support in #35627. While primarily a refactor, it touches critical crash-safety and flush invariants in block storage and makes the subsystem testable in isolation.
